name: one-take
description: One Take: record a lecture video from slides and your voice, with pauses removed, then export to MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV, HLS or DASH at any quality.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,magenta "tsc -b packages/shared --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev --workspace @one-take/server" "npm run dev --workspace @one-take/client"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.doctor: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && node packages/server/dist/doctor.js
